label: W34 self-built PPO learning-curve baseline (synthetic reach task, CPU; not a real-env or Atlas baseline)

task.name: reach
task.description: constant observation [1.0]; 1-D continuous action; reward = -(action - 0.7)^2; fixed 16-step episodes

notes: Baseline exists so the W35 framework bake-off (verl / RLinf) is scored against a known-correct reference implementation on the same task.

Hyperparameter sensitivity measured on this task: lr=3e-2 diverges (policy mean runs away to ~13.9 within 3 updates); lr=1e-2 converges on all 6 seeds; lr=3e-3 converges more slowly (~-4 after 20 updates).
entropy_coef matters: with entropy_coef=0.0 and lr=1e-2, seed 42 collapses sigma early and gets stuck at mean=-2.06 (episode return -121). The PPOConfig default 0.01 fixes all 6 seeds.
log_std is clamped to [-5, 2] inside PPOActor.distribution; without the clamp, early positive advantages far from the mean inflate sigma.
Real-env (FrankaKitchen / MuJoCo) PPO numbers are pending the mujoco+dm_control install; this file is NOT a substitute for that.
No NPU path is exercised here — Atlas PPO throughput is gated on W20 (.to('npu') migration).
